title: Mapping ChatGPT in Mainstream Media to Unravel Jobs and Diversity Challenges: Early Quantitative Insights through Sentiment Analysis and Word Frequency Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Word frequency and sentiment analysis of mainstream news headlines about ChatGPT using keywords such as "woman" and "gender" to identify their underrepresentation and media sentiment.
Word frequency analysis of mainstream news headlines using keywords such as "race" and "black" to evaluate the exclusion of minoritized groups from the mainstream media's agenda regarding AI.

Word frequency analysis and comparative sentiment analysis (automated VADER vs. human manual labeling) of news headlines containing the keyword "job" to assess the media's framing and underrepresentation of AI's impact on labor.
